messages.author: 8c4b9799ec128ecd
messages.subject: Problem with geom_text
parts:
Hi

I have a problem with geom_text. For example following code works:

qplot(x = cyl, y = disp, data = mtcars) + geom_text(data =
data.frame( x = 6, y= 10), map=aes(x=x, y=y), label = "Text")

However, adding a colour variable breaks the code. For example:

> qplot(x = cyl, y = disp, data = mtcars, colour = cyl) + geom_text(data = data.frame( x = 6, y= 10), map=aes(x=x, y=y), label = "Text")
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'cyl' not found

It seems that it does not want to create new layer for text, even
though I have explicitly created new data frame for it. Is there some
way I can avoid the problem?

Best,
Raivo

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Problem with geom_text
parts:
Hi,

I believe the problem is that the new layer inherits the aesthetic
mapping for colour defined in the qplot() call, i.e. it looks for a
variable cyl in the data.frame supplied to geom_text and fails to find
one. You can specifically tell geom_text not to bother with this
mapping, or use annotate,

qplot(x = cyl, y = disp, data = mtcars, colour = cyl) +
geom_text(data = data.frame( x = 6, y= 10), map=aes(x=x, y=y),
qplot(x = cyl, y = disp, data = mtcars, colour = cyl) +

messages.author: 55d1e12d2e4acfaf
messages.subject: Re: Problem with geom_text
parts:
I've seen this before, too. If you specify colour in the first aes
mapping, then you have to specify it in all aes that you use later. So

qplot(x=cyl,y=disp,data=mtcars,colour=cyl) + geom_text(data=data.frame
(x=6,y=10),map=aes(x=x,y=x,colour=NULL),label="Text")

works because you satisfy the inherited structure of the aes.

Perry
